guard/30873.htm.text: Guard Coleman: Follow this road to the east to reach the National Cementery. South of there you'll see a giant cave. It is known as the the Titan Cave. It's not just because the cave is big but there are also rumors that actual Titans still exist there. Have you heard about the Titans?

guard/30873-1.htm.text: Guard Coleman: I've heard from Elven Priest Polonia at the temple that the titans lived on this continent before our five races came. But they made the gods angry and went to ruin. Polonia heard about that cave and said that the titans that fled there to escape the wrath of the gods may have degene…

The final resting place of kings, aristocrats and heroes has fallen into ruin and been overtaken by hideous monsters. Our neglect tempts our ancestors' wrath. The neglect of the kingdom has allowed it to fall into ruins. If we incur our ancestors' wrath, we'll have no one to blame but ourselves. You must use extreme care when you go there. Q00360_PlunderTheirSupplies/30873-05.htm.text: Guard Coleman: Why are you still here? Your must subjugate Taik Orc seekers and Taik Orc supply leaders . You can't go back on your word! You don't intend to do that, do you?

links.text: "I'll help you, but I expect to be paid very well."

But alas, our guards are having a hard time dealing with their forces. The captain has ordered me to find someone wh…

Q00360_PlunderTheirSupplies/30873-04.htm.text: Guard Coleman: I wish you luck. You will be compensated based on the amount of supplies you bring back from the orcs. If you happen to find an important document , please bring it to me as well. In our current predicament, any amount of enemy intelligence would be very helpful.

Q00360_PlunderTheirSupplies/30873-09.htm.text: Guard Coleman: Thank you! I'm sure you will continue to have great results. Bring me any supplies and documents you take from the Taik orcs and I will give you a generous reward... Hurry!

Q00360_PlunderTheirSupplies/30873-10.htm.text: Guard Coleman: Ah, yes... I understand... We all have our own path to follow... I shouldn't try to stop you.
